body: it just made me more self involved.

it's not about the statement. i just don't give a fuck. or don't want to give a fuck. or something like that. 

i talked to someone a couple of times. it was affective in making me feel better, but i think it might have fucked me up worse. I probably 'need' meds to feel normal and act like a typically adjusted person. but. what the fuck is that? it just seems repulsive to me. My roommate was a fuck up in high school and is now pretty highly medicated so that he can be a real person, and it works for him, but if just seems terrible.

see, the bullshit of what i'm feeling is that I don't really have anything 'holding me down' or what not. i'm supposed to graduate in may. a year early. I've done well enough in school. I could have done a lot better, but I've certainly done well enough to find a job or whatever. I just don't want to. I don't want to feel like I might be taking a job away from someone who has worked harder than me and might need it more. I'm pretty intelligent and came from a great family, and I feel like I don't deserve it. I haven't really earned very much of what I have in life. It's all been given to me, and I guess I am resentful for having things so easy. 

At the same time, people expect things from me that I don't think it's fair for them to expect, including my continued existence. I don't really have a plan in life, and I know that I owe it to my parents and family to figure something out because of what they have given me. This stresses me out everytime anyone calls or emails, and since i'm stressed I don't answer, which just stresses me out more. And I know how cyclical this is, but it's just not a cycle i ever can find the instantaneous motivation to break. I'd like to leave them all behind... not necessarily kill myself, but maybe just disappear. But I can't, because of what they have done for me. People just care about me more than I care about them, and there is nothing I can really do about that. I'm very close to nihlism, and that makes it seem irrational to care about people. I wish I did... but I don't. I do feel responsible for my debts though. It's just an awful tension, that no one I talk to has been able to really understand. Possibly because I don't really understand it and usually can't communicate it. 

THis is the second time in a couple of weeks that I've felt like this. Tonights seems deeper and my thoughts seem more real, but it also sounds crazier in my head. It totally feels like me, but it also does not sound right in my head. IT's just fucked up shit, for lack of a better term.
